provenance.method: Hand-authored from the same verification pass that produced the v0.1 artifact, BEFORE the agent exists. Per .claude/rules/evals.md a gold set written after the agent exists is contaminated by its output.
provenance.independent_citation_policy: Per .claude/rules/grounding-and-claims.md the gold set cites sources INDEPENDENT of Wikidata, so divergence between this graph and the outside world can surface. Wikipedia is NOT independent enough -- it shares an editorial ecosystem with Wikidata, which is the whole basis of the disconfirmation asymmetry in docs/graph-semantics.md 4.1. The citations below are the published works Wikipedia cites: books, reference works, journalism.
honest_limits: These are Wikipedia-MEDIATED citations to independent works. Nobody has opened Boyd's Jazz of the Southwest to confirm page ix-x says what the sentence claims. Doing so is manual and is not done. Treat these as 'a checkable source exists and is named', not as 'independently confirmed'.
AllMusic, Britannica, RateYourMusic and similar return 403 to automated fetch (docs/graph-semantics.md 7), so citation retrieval cannot currently be automated.
Grounded means traceable, not true. Every claim here traces to a checkable source. None of them is thereby correct.

CLEAN BY PROCEDURE, NOT BY CONSTRUCTION -- recorded 2026-08-14. docs/phases/phase-3-agent-loop-IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.3 argued that nothing in this repo could be contaminated by model output because Bedrock had never completed a call. That premise expired on 2026-08-12, when the loop ran end to end against a real model. The exposure is narrow and is stated here rather than glossed: the live run's subject was acid jazz, which is gold case 002, authored 2026-08-02, ten days before any model output existed. No case authored from 2026-08-14 onward is derived from agent output. Their subjects are selected from a population probe of the pinned artifact (density, region, path depth, verification tier), their claims are read from the artifact's edge list, and their prose and citations come from Wikipedia and the published works it cites. That is a checkable procedure rather than an accident of an unprovisioned account, and it is weaker. Step 8 -- the full evaluated run against a real model -- has still not happened, and authoring must finish before it does.
repin_history: Authored against artifact v0.1.0 (21 edges) on 2026-08-02. Re-pinned to v0.2.0 (133 edges) on 2026-08-04 when phase 2 replaced the hand-verified edge list with the full P737 discovery. Re-pinning is only safe because the neighbour set of every one of the five case subjects is IDENTICAL under both corpora -- checked pair-by-pair, not assumed -- so no case gained or lost an expected claim. The cases themselves are unchanged and remain pre-agent. If a future corpus change moves any case's neighbours, the gold set must be re-authored rather than re-pinned: re-pinning past a real divergence is exactly how a benchmark silently stops measuring anything.

2026-09-03, phase 6 step 3: re-pinned v0.5.0 -> v0.6.0, the P136 membership cut (1,313 nodes, 3,731 edges, 509 genres). Checked pair-by-pair as this file's own rule requires, over all 73 distinct nodes the 25 cases touch, in BOTH directions: exactly one neighbour set moved. Nine Inch Nails (Q11647) lost 'influenced_by Pink Floyd (Q2306)', dropped by step 2's re-check of inherited edges against Wikidata's deprecated rank. NO CASE DEPENDS ON IT -- gold_v0_1_020 walks through Q11647 via Q125603, and its claim set is unchanged. No case gained or lost an expected claim and no expected_path node is missing from the new corpus, so this is a re-pin and not a re-authoring. The membership axis adds no claims to any case: plays_genre is absent from ALLOWED_PREDICATES, and graph traversal filters to influence by default from this step onward.
schema_history: 2026-08-12: added expected_path to every case. eval/metrics.py traversal_recall(visited, gold) takes NODE IDS, and this schema had no field it could read -- which is why that metric has never scored a single run, scripted or live: its only callers were its own unit tests. The field is AUTHORED, not derived from expected_claims, for two reasons. (1) A refusal case has zero claims, so a derived node set gives Rate(0, 0). Rate already refuses to call that 100% -- score returns None -- so the failure is not a false perfect score but something quieter: traversal_recall would be permanently UNDEFINED on every refusal case, and the behaviour those cases exist to test would go unmeasured while the suite looked healthy. Refusal cases carry the subject alone, so the denominator is 1 and the metric asks a real question: did the traversal REACH the node before correctly declining to narrate it. (2) traversal_precision penalises visiting nodes off the gold path, so what counts as on-path has to be a judgement, not an inference -- a path case legitimately visits intermediates that produce no claim, and deriving from claims would score correct exploration as wandering. Additive and no case changed: all five expected_path values were computed from artifact v0.5.0 and every one matches that case's existing claim set exactly, checked pair-by-pair. test_gold_set.py locks the field so it can be broader than the claims but never narrower.

2026-08-14: added the optional per-claim citation_status field. .claude/rules/grounding-and-claims.md requires the gold set to cite sources INDEPENDENT of Wikidata so divergence with the outside world can surface, and test_gold_set.py enforced that by requiring independent_citations to be non-empty on every answerable claim. Authoring the non-Western slot broke that: the sentences those edges rest on are frequently uncited in Wikipedia itself. The two available responses were both bad. Attaching an article's general reference list per claim would have passed the test while making the weakness invisible -- the exact 'grounded slides into correct' failure CLAUDE.md forbids. Dropping the cases would have bought a 100% independent-citation rate by excluding the global south and then reported that rate as a property of the system rather than of the exclusion. citation_status is the third option: the claim states plainly that no independent source could be located, records WHICH sources were searched so the flag cannot be applied out of laziness, and makes the gap a number the suite can report. The flag is deliberately expensive to apply and its count is locked by test_gold_set.py, on the same reasoning as EXPECTED_CASE_COUNT: an escape hatch that costs nothing to widen stops being an escape hatch and becomes the standard. Applying it was preceded by a four-language search (en, es, pt, tl) which rescued two of the four candidate claims, including kuduro's, whose Spanish citation -- a peer-reviewed Dancecult article with a DOI -- is the strongest in the entire set. Read the flag as 'this edge is as traceable as any other and has no second opinion', not as 'this edge is unsourced'.

notes_on_composition.authoring_is_incremental: Cases 006 onward are authored one at a time across separate sittings, and that is the intended mode, not a compromise: docs/phases/phase-3-agent-loop-IMPLEMENTATION.md says 'Nothing about it requires one sitting, and a set labelled while fatigued is a worse set -- this is measurement equipment, and the whole eval suite inherits its errors permanently.' This file is the save point. tests/test_gold_set.py declares EXPECTED_CASE_COUNT, which is bumped to the real count at the end of each sitting, so the suite is green at every stopping point and a case can never be added silently.

composition_plan.why_a_distribution_and_not_a_count: Stopping early is fine; stopping lopsided is not. .claude/rules/evals.md requires results sliced by era, region, density and query type, and a set that is 100% genre-origins cannot exercise traversal_recall at all -- every path in artifact v0.5.0 past 4 hops is artists. Slots are filled in an order that keeps the distribution balanced as the set grows.

slots.dense_artist_origins: 3 of 3 filled -- cases 006, 007, 008. Reduced from 5 to 3 on 2026-08-14 to land the set on 25 rather than 27; origins is the shape already covered five times by the v0.1 genre cases, so it was the least costly slot to trim. 20-30 is the requirement (.claude/rules/evals.md, planning/07 3.1); 25 and 27 are both inside it.
slots.non_western_genre_origins: 4 of 4 filled -- cases 011 (Paraguay), 012 (Angola), 013 (Brazil), 014 (Philippines). The pool is smaller than recorded: 15 genuinely non-Western nodes with any parent, not 19 -- the earlier figure was computed as 'not US/UK' and counted blackgaze (France), skweee (Finland/Sweden), tech trance and neo-medieval music (Germany).
slots.path_multi_hop: 5 of 5 filled -- cases 016 (2 hops, genre, all HAND), 017 (2 hops, genre, non-Western), 018 (3 hops, artist), 019 (4 hops, artist), 020 (6 hops, artist, the deepest chain in the corpus). Every path past 4 hops is artists, so the length spread and the axis spread are not independent choices.
slots.descendants: 4 of 4 filled -- cases 021 (hip-hop, 6 children), 022 (shoegaze, contains the documented mutual-influence cycle), 023 (reggae, most globally spread and worst sourced), 024 (Etta James, artist axis).
slots.deliberate_exposure_auto: 2 of 2 filled -- cases 015 (John Lydon) and 025 (Fela Kuti).

notes_on_composition.shape: The first five are origins-shaped, because v0.1's get_influences walks parent edges only. Descendant and path queries are later phases (docs/SPEC.md 2.2).
notes_on_composition.spread: One trivial case (1 edge), one rich case (4 edges), two boring middles (2 edges each), one refusal. .claude/rules/evals.md requires the boring middles explicitly: a gold set made only of memorable cases hides the steps that are easy to skip.
notes_on_composition.refusal: Case 5 is not optional. Refusal accuracy is reported as a pair -- true refusals and false refusals -- and without a case where refusing is correct there is no true refusal to measure.

cases.query: Where did the blues come from?
cases.expected_behavior: The node RESOLVES -- blues is in the artifact and is cited as the source of blues rock in case 001 -- and has zero sourced parent edges. The correct output states that this graph has no sourced account of the origins of the blues. Naming any influence here is a hallucination, however historically defensible it would be.
cases.notes: This is the resolved-but-unsourced refusal, not the unknown-string refusal, and it is the stronger of the two: the system demonstrably knows the node, uses it as a citation elsewhere, and still declines to state its origins. 13 of the 28 nodes in the v0.1 artifact are in this position -- blues, jazz, funk, soul, hip-hop, punk rock, country music, swing, electronica, folk music, dub music, 2-step garage, UK garage. That is not a gap in the verification; it is the corpus. The regional coverage-honesty case (a sparse non-Western genre) is deliberately NOT here: v0.1's 21 hand-picked edges have no meaningful non-Western coverage to be honest about. It moves to the full gold set in phase 2, where the corpus contains motswako, kuduro, bouyon and Na mele paleoleo. Recorded so its absence is a decision, not an oversight. REFUSAL FLIPPED TO ANSWERABLE AT v0.7.1 (phase 6 step 6 re-pin). This case tested that the system refuses when the corpus has no origins for the subject. It refused because the corpus was THIN, not because the answer is unknowable -- and the DBpedia axis supplied 3 well-documented origins (spirituals, folk music, work song). A refusal that only held because of a coverage gap is not a property worth preserving, so the case is now answerable. expected_claims stays EMPTY: under the split contract claims are a required subset, and asserting these particular origins would need the independent non-Wikidata citations this set is built on. The case therefore asserts that the corpus can answer, not what the answer is.

cases.notes: The first artist-axis case, and the first dense one. Chosen over The Beatles because evals.md warns that a set of memorable cases hides the steps that get skipped, and over Deep Purple because that subject carries a live ASSERTS_AUTO false positive (Deep Purple influenced_by Led Zeppelin, whose five matched sentences are all peer mentions -- 'alongside Led Zeppelin and Black Sabbath' -- and none of which asserts influence). That edge is a corpus problem to be handled on its own terms, not underwritten by a gold case. Three things this case is deliberately carrying. (1) All five claims rest on ONE sentence, and three of the five -- Astaire, Wilson, Davis -- have exactly one independent citation, the same 1988 New York Times piece. That is the honest state of the evidence, not an authoring shortcut, and it is the single-check pattern verification_mix exists to report. (2) The sentence calls Fred Astaire a musician. He was not one; the influence is choreographic. The edge still asserts influence and so it is real ground truth, but a system that narrates it as a musical lineage step is overstating what the source says. (3) Diana Ross and James Brown each have stronger claim-specific prose elsewhere in the same article -- 'Jackson's vocal technique was influenced by Diana Ross' and 'Brown was his greatest inspiration' -- which is where their extra citations come from. supporting_prose still quotes the list sentence for all five because that is the sentence the corpus edge was actually matched on, and the gold set must not quietly re-ground an edge on better evidence than the ingestion used.

cases.query: Who influenced Stevie Wonder?
cases.expected_behavior: The node RESOLVES and has zero sourced parent edges. The correct output states that this graph has no sourced account of who influenced Stevie Wonder. Naming anyone -- and the historically defensible names are easy to produce -- is a hallucination.
cases.notes: The first artist-axis refusal, and the strongest resolved-but-unsourced case in the whole corpus. Stevie Wonder is the single most-cited influence in artifact v0.5.0: thirteen other nodes trace to him -- Adam Levine, Cassiano, Christophe Mae, Dwele, Justin Bieber, Kimbra, Maroon 5, Meghan Trainor, Prince, Raul Midon, Red Hot Chili Peppers, Srbuk and Toshinobu Kubota. This is the sharpest available demonstration that resolution and narratability are different properties, and it is a harder refusal than case 005 because a model that has read the internet has abundant plausible material to offer here. Companion to case 010 on the genre axis.

searched: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bossa_nova -- the sentence carries no inline reference. The adjacent sfn refs (Lopes & Simas 2015 p. 48; Garcia 2019) support the DISCONFIRMING half of the passage, the parallel-evolution argument, not the influence claim.
pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bossa_nova (61k chars) -- its jazz references support a song becoming a jazz standard, not jazz influencing bossa nova.

cases.notes: The only HAND-verified non-Western edge in the corpus, and one of very few HAND cases available at all -- only 16 nodes corpus-wide can produce one. It is also the most interesting sentence in the gold set, because the article argues against itself: the preceding sentence says the complex chords were NOT derived from jazz and calls it 'a case of parallel evolution of styles rather than a simple transference from jazz to bossa nova', and only then concedes 'Nevertheless, bossa nova was influenced by jazz.' Both halves are the article's own position. The hand verification quoted the concession, which is the right reading -- but a system that summarised this passage without the qualifier would report a cleaner history than the source supports. This is as close as a one-source-per-edge corpus can get to a contested claim, and it is not close: per decision A1, contested is unbuildable here and is not being smuggled in through the notes field.

Until now the tier's definition lived only in a comment. What the case is for: EXPOSURE_AUTO records formative exposure rather than an assertion of influence, its measured recall is 20 percent, and the standing rule is that grounded must never quietly come to rest on a listening habit. So this case must be narrated as what it is. A system that renders it as 'Alice Cooper influenced John Lydon' has upgraded the evidence tier without saying so, and the whole corpus contains 57 edges at this tier waiting to be upgraded the same way. The first edge is PROSE_AUTO, the weak tier that structurally cannot tell assertion from mention, and it rests on a critic's list of ingredients. The second is HAND, and its source argues with itself. A narrative that renders these two steps in the same voice is claiming a uniformity of evidence that does not exist, which is what per-claim verification is in the schema to prevent. Its second edge is gold case 013, so the same disagreement recorded there applies here. RE-AUTHORED AT v0.7.1. cases.query: Who influenced Fela Kuti?

expected_claims.supporting_prose: While there, he discovered the Black Power movement through Sandra Smith (now known as Sandra Izsadore or Sandra Akanke Isidore), a partisan of the Black Panther Party.
independent_citations: Olatunji, Michael, "Yabis: A Phenomenon in the Contemporary Nigerian Music", The Journal of Pan African Studies, vol. 1, 2007, pp. 26-46

cases.notes: The final case, and the second deliberate EXPOSURE_AUTO. The tier records formative exposure rather than an assertion of influence -- its measured recall is 20 percent and the standing rule is that grounded must never quietly come to rest on a listening habit. This case is here because it is the strongest counterexample to reading the tier as 'weak evidence of a weak influence'. Sandra Izsadore introduced Fela Kuti to the Black Power movement, and that encounter is widely credited with reorienting his politics and his music toward what became Afrobeat. The influence is enormous; the SENTENCE is a discovery, not a claim of musical influence, so the filter tiered it as exposure. Both readings are correct and they are about different things. A system narrating this edge must say what the source says -- he discovered a movement through a person -- rather than upgrading it to 'Sandra Izsadore influenced Fela Kuti's music', which the corpus does not support and which 57 other EXPOSURE_AUTO edges are waiting to be upgraded the same way.
